name: Touch and UI responsiveness (Qualcomm boot tuning)
description: Android applies its atoll tuning from init.qcom.post_boot.sh, which HarmonyOS never runs, so the phone ran on kernel defaults. Once boot completes a script turns core_ctl off, applies the stock big.LITTLE placement and frequency floors, enables the kernel touch boost on both clusters with an immediate move to the big cores, sets prefer_idle through schedtune, and gives multimodalinput and composer_host nice -20. It logs the resulting state to kmsg as curtana-tune.
